nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=75 beats='Miri arrives at school coop with grain pail, greets three hens by name: Goldie, Speckles, Pip. Morning is sunny and quiet. choices.label: Search the coop and run carefully

choices.label: Squeeze through the gap to follow Pip

choices.label: Enter the shed slowly and quietly
